human_sources.title: Actions of discrete amenable groups on injective factors of type III-lambda, lambda not one
human_sources.role: The global criterion and the reduction through a countable section are due to Sutherland–Takesaki [ST], Assumption 4.1 and Theorem 4.2 (pp.427–431). Their proof identifies the stabilizers and inner kernel, compares the return characteristic and trace classes, and reconstructs the global comparison. The present cyclic specialization proves the three centre-flow alternatives, repairs the trace and the implementing pair on invariant conull domains, and supplies a transverse invariant mean. The common scalar quotient in Section 4 retains the relative phase of the two implementers. These details explain the classical classification mechanism.
